identity.product_outcome: Source-bound obligations are reachable in People with explicit provenance, exact Person/Song bindings, evidence history and stale-action protection.
identity.artist_job: Capture and review real open loops without a declaration silently becoming an observed trigger or an external action.

bounded_increment.description: Compose canonical ObligationMemory into HeadquartersMemory and expose source-bound obligation creation/review in People.

semantic_contract.required_behavior: Expose canonical obligations through People while preserving provenance, exact identity/lifecycle bindings, evidence-only user trigger declarations, and zero external-action authority.
non_negotiable_semantics: ObligationMemory remains the canonical obligation foundation rather than creating a second owner
created obligations bind to an existing Person and optionally the exact current Song
creation and lifecycle judgments retain USER_DECLARED provenance
stale lifecycle actions fail by exact rendered lifecycle binding
a user-declared trigger remains scoped USER_DECLARED evidence and never becomes a canonical observed trigger event
declared trigger evidence does not satisfy the trigger or move timing out of WAITING_FOR_TRIGGER
trigger-declaration actions bind to lifecycle state, canonical trigger-event sequence and latest declared-evidence sequence
no messaging, calendar, payment, licensing, provider, Release, DAW or other external-action authority is created
allowed_implementation_freedom: People presentation structure while preserving exact title and semantics
test harness structure that preserves one-shot action behavior
interpretations_required: Canonical record_trigger represents observation and must not be called by a mere user declaration.

behavior.requested_behavior: Expose source-bound obligations and their lifecycle/evidence truth inside People.
behavior.implemented_behavior: Composes ObligationMemory, creates Person/Song-bound obligations, displays timing/trigger/consequence/dependency/lifecycle/attention/evidence, rejects stale actions and records trigger declarations as evidence-only without satisfying canonical triggers.

consumer_path.path: /people -> People and open loops -> source-bound obligation creation/review/actions
consumer_path.proof: Historical focused consumer coverage exercises creation, stale lifecycle binding and trigger-declaration truth; fresh exact-head H0 proof is required after reconstruction.
